items.title: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE (BlockStrap)
items.summary: BlockStrap is a CVSS 10.0 Magento and Adobe Commerce flaw that gives unauthenticated attackers remote code execution. Adobe fixed it on October 13 in APSB26-153 but requires a manual patch, and new installs remain vulnerable.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This update addresses vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium that could result in arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. The most critical issue is BlockStrap (CVE-2026-103849), a template engine injection at CVSS 10.0.

items.title: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE (StyleSmuggler) under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a Magento and Adobe Commerce zero-day that gives unauthenticated attackers remote code execution, with attacks starting on September 4th. Adobe released an emergency hotfix for this critical vulnerability (CVSS 10.0) on September 7, 2026, as part of APSB26-146.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe has released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source that resolves a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650) that could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware of CVE-2026-75650 being exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released a regularly scheduled security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe has released a security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, addressing critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover with a CVSS score of 9.1 (CVE-2026-71362).

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability in Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. Indications have emerged that threat actors are attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes (CVE-2026-53787) lets attackers write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce, Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce Webhooks
items.summary: Adobe has released a security update for Adobe Commerce, Magento Open Source, and Adobe Commerce Webhooks, addressing critical vulnerabilities.
